card.name: Just before historical dates and eras
card.fires_on: Small words, spaces or first digits right before a historical year or decade, such as 'during the' 1830s or around 1890, and 'early' before 'days'. It appears in history-of-technology passages.

modes.label: Before a decade
modes.description: The word 'the' or the space just before an 1800s decade in a history passage.

modes.label: Inside a year
modes.description: The first digit or space before a late-1800s year.

modes.label: Early-period wording
modes.description: The word 'early' or 'since' or 'until' leading into a period of time.
modes.example: But in the<< early>> days these were all too ordinary.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about early periods, history and patents or inventions, including Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to name an old year or era, as in the history of inventions.
evidence: But in the<< early>> days these were all too ordinary.
